mapper.select: SELECT pr.id, pr.sku_id AS skuId, pr.unit_id AS unitId, un.name AS unitName, pr.price_type AS priceType, pr.partner_type AS partnerType, pr.partner_id AS partnerId, pr.customer_level AS customerLevel, pr.price, pr.tax_rate AS taxRate, pr.include_tax AS includeTax, pr.enabled FROM product_price pr LEFT JOIN product_unit un ON un.id = pr.unit_id AND un.delete_flag = '0' WHERE pr.sku_id = #{skuId} AND pr.delete_flag = '0' ORDER BY pr.id
